question: ‘Mati-Akhora’ is associated with which of the following classical dances of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sattriya__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **In Assamese**, generally, **Mati-Akhora means exercise done on the ground**.
 
• The Sattriya dance training begins with these Mati-Akhoras.
 
• **Mati-Akhoras** are a foundation for the learners to make a healthy** physical, mental, and spiritual **set-up which is very necessary for a classical dancer.
